correctness.rationale: The four input-count outputs 0,1,0,1 are precisely parity of 3 neighbor bits; no self-input is used. In R=F2[z]/(z^n-1), the two layer block transforms to [[f,1],[0,f]] with f=(z²+z+1)/z. Invertibility iff 3∤n follows from roots of q=z²+z+1 of order 3. For 3|n, CRT q-primary factor q^t has binary dimension 2t, giving two-copy nilpotent index max(2,t), periodic core codimension 4t and attained transient depth. For n=2^k, repeated Frobenius squaring gives M^(2^j)=diag(1+P^(2^j),1+P^(2^j)) for j>=1 and powers of cyclic shift, while fixed points for j=0 have dimension 4; exact order n/2 follows from strict previous fixed-space inclusion. Independent GF2 bit-matrix checks n3..32 and dyadic up to n64 corroborate all formulas; they are not the infinite proof.

For 3|n periodic core has 2^(2n-4t) states with t=2^v2(n), maximum transient max(2,t). For dyadic n>=4, all states periodic, maximum least period n/2, and complete fixed-state/cycle counts F0=16, Fj=2^(2 min(n,2^(j+1))).
